    ob.sub_line_name,
    COUNT(*) AS oci_client_count

    ob.sbu_name,

SELECT DISTINCT
    ip.investor_code,
    ip.legal_name,
    ip.client_segment
FROM investor_profile AS ip
INNER JOIN investor_goal AS ig
    ON ig.investor_sk = ip.investor_sk
WHERE ig.goal_category = 'Retirement'
  AND ig.target_amount > 10000000
ORDER BY ip.investor_code ASC

    ap.region,
    COUNT(*) AS active_advisor_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ap.revenue_share_pct), 2) AS average_revenue_share_pct
FROM advisor_profile AS ap
WHERE ap.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY ap.region
ORDER BY ap.region
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT i.product_family, i.asset_class_name, COUNT(*) AS trade_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(t.brokerage, 0)), 2) AS brokerage_inr

SELECT
    ap.advisor_code,
    ap.advisor_full_name,
    kt.target_new_clients,
    COUNT(ip.investor_sk) AS actual_new_clients
FROM kpi_advisor_target AS kt
JOIN advisor_profile AS ap
    ON ap.advisor_sk = kt.advisor_sk
LEFT JOIN investor_profile AS ip
    ON ip.acquiring_advisor_sk = kt.advisor_sk
   AND ip.onboarding_date >= kt.period_start_date
   AND ip.onboarding_date <= kt.period_end_date
   AND ip.is_current = TRUE
   AND ip.is_deleted = FALSE

    ap.advisor_code,
    ap.advisor_full_name,

HAVING COUNT(ip.investor_sk) < kt.target_new_clients

WITH fy2025_target AS (
    SELECT
        kat.advisor_sk,
        kat.target_revenue_inr
    FROM kpi_advisor_target AS kat
    WHERE kat.target_period = 'FY2025'
      AND kat.period_start_date = DATE '2025-04-01'
      AND kat.period_end_date = DATE '2026-03-31'
),
fy2025_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        tfr.primary_advisor_sk AS advisor_sk,
        SUM(tfr.gross_revenue_inr) AS achieved_revenue_inr
    FROM txn_firm_revenue AS tfr
    WHERE tfr.revenue_date >= DATE '2025-04-01'
      AND tfr.revenue_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
    GROUP BY tfr.primary_advisor_sk
)
SELECT
    ap.advisor_code,
    ap.advisor_full_name,
    ROUND(fy2025_revenue.achieved_revenue_inr / 10000000.0, 4) AS achieved_revenue_crore,
    ROUND(fy2025_target.target_revenue_inr / 10000000.0, 4) AS target_revenue_crore,
    ROUND(100.0 * fy2025_revenue.achieved_revenue_inr / NULLIF(fy2025_target.target_revenue_inr, 0), 4) AS achievement_pct
FROM fy2025_target
JOIN advisor_profile AS ap
  ON ap.advisor_sk = fy2025_target.advisor_sk
LEFT JOIN fy2025_revenue
  ON fy2025_revenue.advisor_sk = fy2025_target.advisor_sk
WHERE COALESCE(fy2025_revenue.achieved_revenue_inr, 0) >= 0.5 * fy2025_target.target_revenue_inr
ORDER BY achievement_pct DESC, ap.advisor_code
LIMIT 1000

WITH RECURSIVE advisor_current AS (
    SELECT
        advisor_sk,
        advisor_code,
        advisor_full_name,
        line_manager_advisor_sk
    FROM advisor_profile
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
), chains AS (
    SELECT
        a.advisor_sk AS target_advisor_sk,
        a.advisor_code AS target_advisor_code,
        a.advisor_full_name AS target_advisor_full_name,
        a.line_manager_advisor_sk,
        a.advisor_full_name AS management_chain,
        0 AS depth
    FROM advisor_current AS a

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.target_advisor_sk,
        c.target_advisor_code,
        c.target_advisor_full_name,
        m.line_manager_advisor_sk,
        m.advisor_full_name || ' > ' || c.management_chain,
        c.depth + 1
    FROM chains AS c
    JOIN advisor_current AS m
      ON m.advisor_sk = c.line_manager_advisor_sk
)
SELECT
    target_advisor_code AS advisor_code,
    target_advisor_full_name AS advisor_full_name,
    management_chain
FROM chains
WHERE line_manager_advisor_sk IS NULL
ORDER BY target_advisor_code
LIMIT 1000

WITH advisor_client_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ap.advisor_code,
        ap.advisor_full_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN ip.is_active = TRUE
             AND ip.is_deleted = FALSE
             AND ip.is_current = TRUE
            THEN ip.investor_sk
        END) AS active_client_count
    FROM advisor_profile AS ap
    LEFT JOIN investor_profile AS ip
        ON ip.primary_advisor_sk = ap.advisor_sk
    WHERE ap.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY ap.advisor_code, ap.advisor_full_name
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY active_client_count DESC) AS advisor_rank,
    advisor_code,
    advisor_full_name,
    active_client_count,
    ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY active_client_count ASC) * 100, 2) AS percentile_rank_pct
FROM advisor_client_counts
ORDER BY advisor_rank, advisor_code
LIMIT 1000

WITH calendar_months AS (
    SELECT month_start::DATE AS month_start
    FROM generate_series(
        DATE '2023-12-01',
        DATE '2024-12-01',
        INTERVAL '1 month'
    ) AS series(month_start)
), monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cm.month_start,
        COUNT(tt.trade_sk) AS trade_count
    FROM calendar_months AS cm
    LEFT JOIN txn_trade AS tt
        ON tt.trade_date >= cm.month_start
       AND tt.trade_date < cm.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
    GROUP BY cm.month_start
), with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        trade_count,
        LAG(trade_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_trade_count
    FROM monthly_counts
)
SELECT
    month_start,
    trade_count,
    previous_trade_count,
    trade_count - previous_trade_count AS absolute_mom_change,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (trade_count - previous_trade_count) / NULLIF(previous_trade_count, 0),
        2
    ) AS percentage_change
FROM with_previous
WHERE month_start >= DATE '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY month_start
LIMIT 1000;

WITH advisor_desk_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        r.business_unit_sk,
        ou.sbu_code,
        ou.sbu_name,
        ou.business_line_code,
        ou.business_line_name,
        ou.sub_line_code AS desk_code,
        ou.sub_line_name AS desk_name,
        a.advisor_code,
        a.advisor_full_name,
        SUM(r.gross_revenue_inr) AS total_revenue_inr
    FROM txn_firm_revenue AS r
    JOIN org_business_unit AS ou
      ON ou.business_unit_sk = r.business_unit_sk
    JOIN advisor_profile AS a
      ON a.advisor_sk = r.primary_advisor_sk
    WHERE r.revenue_date >= DATE '2025-04-01'
      AND r.revenue_date < DATE '2026-04-01'
    GROUP BY
        r.business_unit_sk,
        ou.sbu_code,
        ou.sbu_name,
        ou.business_line_code,
        ou.business_line_name,
        ou.sub_line_code,
        ou.sub_line_name,
        a.advisor_code,
        a.advisor_full_name
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        business_unit_sk,
        sbu_code,
        sbu_name,
        business_line_code,
        business_line_name,
        desk_code,
        desk_name,
        advisor_code,
        advisor_full_name,
        total_revenue_inr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY business_unit_sk
            ORDER BY total_revenue_inr DESC, advisor_code, advisor_full_name
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM advisor_desk_revenue
)
SELECT
    desk_code,
    desk_name,
    business_line_code,
    business_line_name,
    advisor_code,
    advisor_full_name,
    ROUND(total_revenue_inr / 10000000.0, 4) AS total_revenue_crore
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY desk_code
LIMIT 1000

WITH first_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        investor_sk,
        MIN(opened_on) AS first_account_date
    FROM investor_account
    WHERE opened_on IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_sk
), first_trades AS (
    SELECT
        investor_sk,
        MIN(trade_date) AS first_trade_date
    FROM txn_trade
    WHERE trade_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_sk
)
SELECT
    p.investor_code,
    p.legal_name,
    a.first_account_date,
    t.first_trade_date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', a.first_account_date, t.first_trade_date) AS days_between
FROM investor_profile AS p
JOIN first_accounts AS a
    ON a.investor_sk = p.investor_sk
JOIN first_trades AS t
    ON t.investor_sk = p.investor_sk
ORDER BY days_between DESC, p.investor_code ASC
LIMIT 50

WITH investor_ltcg AS (
    SELECT
        ip.investor_sk,
        ip.investor_code,
        ip.legal_name,
        SUM((tlc.matched_sell_unit_price - tlc.matched_buy_unit_cost) * tlc.matched_quantity) AS total_ltcg_gain,
        rt.ltcg_exemption_inr AS exemption_inr,
        rt.ltcg_tax_rate_pct AS tax_rate_pct
    FROM txn_lot_closure AS tlc
    JOIN investor_profile AS ip
        ON ip.investor_sk = tlc.investor_sk
    JOIN instrument_master AS im
        ON im.instrument_sk = tlc.instrument_sk
    JOIN rule_taxation AS rt
        ON rt.asset_class_code = im.asset_class_code
       AND rt.residency_status = ip.residency_status
       AND rt.effective_from <= tlc.sold_on
       AND (rt.effective_to IS NULL OR rt.effective_to >= tlc.sold_on)
    WHERE ip.residency_status = 'Resident'
      AND im.asset_class_code = 'EQ'
      AND tlc.sold_on >= DATE '2024-07-23'
      AND tlc.holding_period_days >= 365
      AND rt.rule_version = 'Budget2024'
    GROUP BY
        ip.investor_sk,
        ip.investor_code,
        ip.legal_name,
        rt.ltcg_exemption_inr,
        rt.ltcg_tax_rate_pct
)
SELECT
    investor_code,
    legal_name,
    ROUND(total_ltcg_gain, 2) AS total_ltcg_gain_inr,
    ROUND(GREATEST(total_ltcg_gain - exemption_inr, 0), 2) AS taxable_ltcg_gain_inr,
    ROUND(tax_rate_pct, 2) AS ltcg_tax_rate_pct,
    ROUND(GREATEST(total_ltcg_gain - exemption_inr, 0) * tax_rate_pct / 100.0, 2) AS total_ltcg_tax_liability_inr
FROM investor_ltcg
ORDER BY total_ltcg_tax_liability_inr DESC, investor_code ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    ip.investor_code,
    tt.trade_reference,
    ia.account_number,
    im.instrument_code,
    im.security_name,
    tlc.closure_sk,
    tlc.sell_trade_sk,
    tlc.sold_on AS sell_date,
    tlc.matched_quantity,
    ROUND(tlc.matched_buy_unit_cost, 4) AS per_unit_buy_lot_cost,
    ROUND(tlc.matched_sell_unit_price, 4) AS per_unit_sell_price,
    ROUND((tlc.matched_sell_unit_price - tlc.matched_buy_unit_cost) * tlc.matched_quantity, 2) AS absolute_profit
FROM txn_lot_closure AS tlc
JOIN txn_trade AS tt
  ON tt.trade_sk = tlc.sell_trade_sk
JOIN instrument_master AS im
  ON im.instrument_sk = tlc.instrument_sk
JOIN investor_profile AS ip
  ON ip.investor_sk = tlc.investor_sk
JOIN investor_account AS ia
  ON ia.account_sk = tlc.account_sk
WHERE im.asset_class_code = 'EQ'
  AND tt.trade_action = 'Sell'
  AND tlc.sold_on >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND tlc.sold_on < DATE '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY absolute_profit DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(tlc.matched_quantity * (tlc.matched_sell_unit_price - tlc.matched_buy_unit_cost)), 2) AS total_stcg_gain,
  ROUND(SUM(tlc.matched_quantity * (tlc.matched_sell_unit_price - tlc.matched_buy_unit_cost)) * 0.15, 2) AS total_stcg_tax,
  COUNT(*) AS matched_lot_closures
FROM txn_lot_closure AS tlc
JOIN instrument_master AS im
  ON im.instrument_sk = tlc.instrument_sk
WHERE tlc.sold_on >= DATE '2024-04-01'
  AND tlc.sold_on < DATE '2024-07-23'
  AND tlc.holding_period_days < 365
  AND im.asset_class_code = 'EQ';

WITH latest_price_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(price_date) AS price_date
    FROM market_price_daily
), latest_prices AS (
    SELECT instrument_sk, close_price, price_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            market_price_daily.instrument_sk,
            market_price_daily.close_price,
            market_price_daily.price_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY market_price_daily.instrument_sk
                ORDER BY market_price_daily.price_sk DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM market_price_daily
        INNER JOIN latest_price_date
            ON market_price_daily.price_date = latest_price_date.price_date
        WHERE market_price_daily.price_type = 'Close'
    ) AS priced
    WHERE rn = 1
), client_losses AS (
    SELECT
        investor_profile.investor_code,
        investor_profile.legal_name,
        investor_profile.client_segment,
        latest_prices.price_date AS as_of_price_date,
        SUM(
            pos_holding_lot.remaining_quantity * pos_holding_lot.acquired_unit_cost
            - pos_holding_lot.remaining_quantity * latest_prices.close_price
        ) AS unrealized_loss_inr
    FROM pos_holding_lot
    INNER JOIN investor_profile
        ON pos_holding_lot.investor_sk = investor_profile.investor_sk
    INNER JOIN instrument_master
        ON pos_holding_lot.instrument_sk = instrument_master.instrument_sk
    INNER JOIN latest_prices
        ON pos_holding_lot.instrument_sk = latest_prices.instrument_sk
    WHERE pos_holding_lot.lot_status IN ('Open', 'Partially Closed')
      AND pos_holding_lot.remaining_quantity > 0
      AND instrument_master.asset_class_code = 'EQ'
    GROUP BY
        investor_profile.investor_code,
        investor_profile.legal_name,
        investor_profile.client_segment,
        latest_prices.price_date
    HAVING SUM(
        pos_holding_lot.remaining_quantity * pos_holding_lot.acquired_unit_cost
        - pos_holding_lot.remaining_quantity * latest_prices.close_price
    ) > 0
)
SELECT
    investor_code,
    legal_name,
    client_segment,
    as_of_price_date,
    ROUND(unrealized_loss_inr / 10000000.0, 4) AS unrealized_loss_crore
FROM client_losses
ORDER BY unrealized_loss_inr DESC, investor_code ASC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
    ap.advisor_code,
    ap.advisor_full_name,
    ap.seniority_band,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(fr.gross_revenue_inr), 0) / 10000000.0, 4) AS actual_gross_revenue_crore,
    ROUND(kat.target_revenue_inr / 10000000.0, 4) AS target_revenue_crore,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN kat.target_revenue_inr = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(SUM(fr.gross_revenue_inr), 0) / kat.target_revenue_inr * 100.0
        END,
        2
    ) AS attainment_percentage
FROM kpi_advisor_target AS kat
JOIN advisor_profile AS ap
    ON ap.advisor_sk = kat.advisor_sk
LEFT JOIN txn_firm_revenue AS fr
    ON fr.primary_advisor_sk = ap.advisor_sk
   AND fr.revenue_date >= DATE '2025-04-01'
   AND fr.revenue_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
WHERE kat.target_period = 'FY2025'
  AND kat.period_start_date = DATE '2025-04-01'
  AND kat.period_end_date = DATE '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY
    ap.advisor_code,
    ap.advisor_full_name,
    ap.seniority_band,
    kat.target_revenue_inr
ORDER BY attainment_percentage DESC NULLS LAST, ap.advisor_code
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_sk) AS rejected_clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active = TRUE THEN p.investor_sk END) AS rejected_clients_with_active_account,
    COUNT(a.account_sk) AS joined_accounts
FROM investor_profile AS p
LEFT JOIN investor_account AS a
    ON a.investor_sk = p.investor_sk
WHERE p.kyc_status = 'Rejected';

SELECT
    a.advisor_code,
    a.advisor_full_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.investor_sk) AS active_client_count
FROM advisor_profile AS a
JOIN investor_profile AS i
    ON i.primary_advisor_sk = a.advisor_sk
WHERE i.is_active = TRUE
  AND i.is_deleted = FALSE
  AND i.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name
ORDER BY active_client_count DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
    ip.investor_code,
    ip.display_name,
    ig.goal_name,
    ig.goal_category,
    ig.target_date,
    ig.is_active
FROM investor_goal AS ig
JOIN investor_profile AS ip
    ON ip.investor_sk = ig.investor_sk
WHERE ig.target_date < DATE '2026-06-10'
  AND ig.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY ig.target_date ASC, ip.investor_code
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS instruments_with_both_ratings
FROM (
    SELECT r.instrument_sk
    FROM instrument_credit_rating AS r
    WHERE r.is_current = TRUE
      AND r.rating_value IN ('AAA', 'D')
    GROUP BY r.instrument_sk
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rating_value = 'AAA' THEN r.rating_value END) > 0
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rating_value = 'D' THEN r.rating_value END) > 0
) AS matching_instruments;
